# How to Use This File

This document retrieves Mandarin CHILDES data, identifies selected logical words, and classifies eligible negators by scope.

Before running:
- Install the required R packages: childesr, tidyverse, arrow, stringr, dplyr, tidyr, and knitr.
- Use the project's mandarin folder as the working directory.
- Ensure the raw_data and processed_data folders exist inside mandarin_data.
- Run the code chunks from top to bottom.

With force_download = FALSE, matching saved raw data are reused when available. Set force_download = TRUE to request a new download. Loading cached raw data skips downloading; subsequent processing still runs.


# Basic package and setup

Load the required packages and configure rendering to display code, stop on errors, and disable automatic chunk caching.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)
library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Loading Data from Childes-DB

Specify the 20 Mandarin corpora included in the analysis.

```{r mandarin_corpora}
# This chunk specifies the 20 Mandarin corpora included in the data request.
mandarin_corpora_names <- c(
  "AcadLang",
  "BJCMC",
  "Chang1",
  "Chang2",
  "ChangPlay",
  "ChangPN",
  "Erbaugh",
  "LiReading",
  "LiZhou",
  "NSCtoys",
  "TCCM",
  "TCCM-reading",
  "Tong",
  "Xinjiang",
  "Zhou1",
  "Zhou2",
  "Zhou3",
  "ZhouAssessment",
  "ZhouDinner",
  "ZhouNarratives"
)
```

Set the database release to 2026.1 and define the download option and storage paths for raw and processed data.

```{r directories}
db_version <- "2026.1"
force_download <- FALSE

data_root <- "mandarin_data"

raw_dir <- file.path(data_root, "raw_data")
processed_dir <- file.path(data_root, "processed_data")
```

Retrieve tokens for target children, mothers, and fathers. Reuse saved data when the database release and query settings match; otherwise, download and save new data after checking the required columns and row counts.

```{r ChildesDBimports}
# Only use caches belonging to the pinned release and the same query.
feather_path <- file.path(raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens.feather")
csv_path <- file.path(raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens.csv")
source_info_path <- file.path(raw_dir, "all_mandarin_tokens_source.rds")

query_roles <- c("Target_Child", "Mother", "Father")
query_info <- list(
  db_version = db_version,
  corpus = sort(mandarin_corpora_names),
  role = sort(query_roles),
  token = "%",
  replace = TRUE
)

cache_info <- if (file.exists(source_info_path)) {
  tryCatch(readRDS(source_info_path), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

cache_matches <- is.list(cache_info) &&
  identical(cache_info$query, query_info)
loaded_from_cache <- FALSE

if (!force_download && cache_matches && file.exists(feather_path)) {
  cat(sprintf("Loading verified childes-db %s Feather cache...\n", db_version))
  all_mandarin_tokens <- arrow::read_feather(feather_path)
  loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else if (!force_download && cache_matches && file.exists(csv_path)) {
  cat(sprintf("Loading verified childes-db %s CSV cache...\n", db_version))
  all_mandarin_tokens <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else {
  cat(sprintf("Downloading tokens from childes-db %s...\n", db_version))

  all_mandarin_tokens <- childesr::get_tokens(
    corpus = mandarin_corpora_names,
    role = query_roles,
    token = "%",
    replace = TRUE,
    db_version = db_version
  )
}

# Avoid saving an empty/failed download or processing incompatible columns.
if (is.null(all_mandarin_tokens) || nrow(all_mandarin_tokens) == 0L) {
  stop("No tokens returned. Check the query messages and corpus names; no cache was saved.")
}

required_columns <- c(
  "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(all_mandarin_tokens))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop("Required columns missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

if (loaded_from_cache && nrow(all_mandarin_tokens) != cache_info$row_count) {
  stop("Cache row count does not match its source record. Set force_download <- TRUE and rerun.")
}

if (!loaded_from_cache) {
  cat("Saving the new data and its release/query information...\n")
  arrow::write_feather(all_mandarin_tokens, feather_path)
  readr::write_csv(all_mandarin_tokens, csv_path)
  saveRDS(
    list(
      query = query_info,
      downloaded_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      childesr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("childesr")),
      row_count = nrow(all_mandarin_tokens)
    ),
    source_info_path
  )
} else if (!file.exists(feather_path)) {
  arrow::write_feather(all_mandarin_tokens, feather_path)
}
```

# Token Processing

## Exclusions

Remove records with missing target-child age or age at least 72 months. Record token totals and distinct child IDs before and after filtering, applying the same age restrictions to child and parent speech.

```{r exclusionsTokens}
# No lowercase conversion needed for Mandarin

# Count tokens before exclusions
n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(all_mandarin_tokens)

# Number of children before exclusions
n_chi_before_exclusions <-
  all_mandarin_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

mandarin_tokens <- all_mandarin_tokens

# Removing rows for which age information for the child does not exist
mandarin_tokens <- 
  mandarin_tokens %>% drop_na(target_child_age)

# Count the tokens after removing NA tokens
n_tokens_ageNAs_removed <- nrow(mandarin_tokens)

# Number of children after excluding NAs
n_chi_ageNAs_removed <-
  mandarin_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

# Take out data for the age range above 6 years (72 months)
mandarin_tokens <-
  mandarin_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age < 72)

# Count the tokens after excluding older than 6 age range
n_tokens_ageOver72mo_removed <- nrow(mandarin_tokens)

# Number of children left after exclusions
n_chi_ageOver72mo_removed <-
  mandarin_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

# Record the dataframe of exclusions
exclusions <-
  data.frame(
    n_tokens_before_exclusions = n_tokens_before_exclusions,
    n_after_ageNAs = n_tokens_ageNAs_removed,
    n_after_age72mo = n_tokens_ageOver72mo_removed,
    missing_age = n_tokens_before_exclusions - n_tokens_ageNAs_removed,
    Over72mo = n_tokens_ageNAs_removed - n_tokens_ageOver72mo_removed,
    n_chi_total = n_chi_before_exclusions,
    n_chi_ageNAs = n_chi_ageNAs_removed,
    n_chi_age72over = n_chi_ageOver72mo_removed
  )
```

Save the exclusion summary and age-filtered token data as CSV files.

```{r savingData}
write_csv(exclusions, file.path(raw_dir, "exclusions_mandarin_summary.csv"))
write_csv(mandarin_tokens, file.path(raw_dir, "mandarin_tokens_excluded.csv"))
```

## Coding Speaker Roles

Label target-child speech as "child" and combine mother and father speech as "parent".

```{r}
# Collapse mothers and fathers into parents
mandarin_tokens$speaker <- "parent"
mandarin_tokens$speaker[mandarin_tokens$speaker_role == "Target_Child"] <- "child"
```

## Coding Age

Group ages into completed months by rounding down; for example, 23.8 months becomes 23.

```{r age}
mandarin_tokens$age <- mandarin_tokens$target_child_age %>% floor()
```

## Grouping Utterance Types

Standardize selected utterance labels by grouping question variants as "interrogative", emphatic imperatives as "imperative", and specified disrupted utterances as "other". Unlisted labels remain unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
# Prepare the utterance_type categories for this study based on the utterance_types in childes-db
## Categories: declarative, imperative, interrogative, and other
mandarin_tokens$utterance_type <-
  recode(mandarin_tokens$utterance_type, 
         question = "interrogative",
         `broken for coding` = "other",
         `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
         interruption = "other",
         `interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `missing CA terminator` = "other",
         `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
         `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
         `quotation next line` = "other",
         `quotation precedes` = "other",
         `self interruption` = "other",
         `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `trail off` = "other",
         `trail off question` = "interrogative"
  )
```

# Defining Function Words in Mandarin
This analysis focuses on four core logical word categories in Mandarin:

* Negation (no/not): 不 (bù, general negation), 不是(bùshì), 没 (méi, negation of have/completion), 没有 (méiyǒu, negation of have/completion)
* Conjunction (and): 和 (hé), 跟 (gēn), 而且 (érqiě, "and also/moreover")
* Disjunction (or): 或者 (huòzhě), 还是 (háishi, "or" in questions)
* Conditionals (if): 如果 (rúguǒ), 要是 (yàoshi, colloquial "if"), 的话 (de hua)

## Defining context

Record the two preceding and two following words and their part-of-speech tags within each utterance. These context variables support subsequent identification and classification of logical words.

```{r betweenwords}
# Keep neighboring-word context within the same transcript and utterance.
mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev2_gloss = lag(gloss, 2),
    prev_gloss = lag(gloss),
    next_gloss = lead(gloss),
    next2_gloss = lead(gloss, 2),
    prev2_pos = lag(part_of_speech, 2),
    prev_pos = lag(part_of_speech),
    next_pos = lead(part_of_speech),
    next2_pos = lead(part_of_speech, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mandarin_tokens$word <- "nonfunction"
```

## Marking Function Words

Identify candidate logical words through exact token matching. Apply additional context rules to identify potential conjunction uses of 跟 (gen) and disjunction uses of 还是 (haishi).

```{r FunctionWords}

function_words <- c(
  # Negation (no/not)
  "不", "不是","没", "没有",
  # Conjunction (and)
  "和", "而且",
  # Disjunction (or)
   "或者",
  # Conditionals (if)
  "如果", "要是", "的话"
)

for (x in function_words) {
  mandarin_tokens$word[mandarin_tokens$gloss == x] <- x
}

# Only mark haishi(还是) when it occurs in an interrogative utterance (the "or" sense).
# In declarative/imperative utterances, 还是 means "still/preferably."
mandarin_tokens$word[
  mandarin_tokens$gloss == "还是" &
  mandarin_tokens$utterance_type == "interrogative"
] <- "还是"

# Only mark gen(跟) when it is likely used as a conjunction ("and"),
# i.e., flanked by nominal-type elements (nouns or pronouns) on both sides.
mandarin_tokens$word[
  mandarin_tokens$gloss == "跟" &
  str_detect(mandarin_tokens$prev_pos, "^(n|pro)") &
  str_detect(mandarin_tokens$next_pos, "^(n|pro)")
] <- "跟"
```

## Word Categories

Group identified words into Negation, Conjunction, Disjunction, and Conditionals, leaving other tokens labeled "nonfunction".

```{r wordcategories}
mandarin_tokens$word_category <- "nonfunction"

mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("不","不是","没", "没有")] <- "Negation"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("和", "跟", "而且")] <- "Conjunction"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("或者", "还是")] <- "Disjunction"
mandarin_tokens$word_category[mandarin_tokens$word %in% c("如果", "要是", "的话")] <- "Conditionals"
```

Mark function vs. nonfunction:

Create a broader distinction between identified function words ("Function") and remaining tokens ("nonfunction").

```{r syncategory}
mandarin_tokens$syncategory <- "Function"
mandarin_tokens$syncategory[mandarin_tokens$word_category == "nonfunction"] <- "nonfunction"
```

# Negation_word normalization

## Categorize bu/bushi/mei/meiyou into four categories without repetition.

Standardize negators into 不 (bu), 不是 (bushi), 没 (mei), and 没有 (meiyou). Recognize adjacent split forms and count each expression once, while excluding recognized 是不是 (shi bu shi) question patterns.

```{r negation_clean}
negation_levels <- c("不", "不是", "没", "没有")

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_adj = coalesce(token_order - lag(token_order) == 1, FALSE),
    next_adj = coalesce(lead(token_order) - token_order == 1, FALSE),

    is_split_start = (gloss == "不" & next_adj & next_gloss == "是") |
                      (gloss == "没" & next_adj & next_gloss == "有"),

    negation_is_continuation = coalesce(lag(is_split_start) & prev_adj, FALSE),

    is_shi_bu_shi = gloss == "是不是" |
      (gloss == "不是" & prev_adj & prev_gloss == "是") |
      (gloss == "不"   & prev_adj & prev_gloss == "是" & next_adj & next_gloss == "是"),

    negation_category = case_when(
      is_shi_bu_shi | negation_is_continuation ~ NA_character_,
      gloss == "不是" | (gloss == "不" & is_split_start) ~ "不是",
      gloss == "没有" | (gloss == "没" & is_split_start) ~ "没有",
      gloss == "不" ~ "不",
      gloss == "没" ~ "没",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    word = case_when(
      negation_is_continuation ~ "nonfunction",
      !is.na(negation_category) ~ negation_category,
      word %in% negation_levels | word_category == "Negation" ~ "nonfunction",
      TRUE ~ coalesce(as.character(word), "nonfunction")
    ),
    word_category = case_when(
      word %in% negation_levels ~ "Negation",
      word %in% c("和", "跟", "而且") ~ "Conjunction",
      word %in% c("或者", "还是") ~ "Disjunction",
      word %in% c("如果", "要是", "的话") ~ "Conditionals",
      TRUE ~ "nonfunction"
    ),
    syncategory = if_else(word_category == "nonfunction", "nonfunction", "Function")
  ) %>%
  
  select(-prev_adj, -next_adj, -is_split_start, -is_shi_bu_shi, -negation_is_continuation)
```

## Exclude non-negation structures (A-not-A, sentence-final affirmative-negative questions)

Identify potential A-not-A constructions and final affirmative-negative questions using local structural rules. Record the exclusion reasons and remove their function-word labels while retaining the token rows for inspection.

```{r negation_remove_nonnegation}

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_adj = coalesce(token_order - lag(token_order) == 1, FALSE),
    next_adj = coalesce(lead(token_order) - token_order == 1, FALSE),
    
    is_end = is.na(next_gloss) |
      coalesce(
        next_adj &
        (
          (gloss == "不" & next_gloss == "是") |
          (gloss == "没" & next_gloss == "有")
        ) &
        is.na(next2_gloss),
      FALSE
    ),

    negation_exclusion = case_when(
      is.na(negation_category) ~ NA_character_,
      # A_not_A format
      prev_adj & next_adj & (
        (gloss %in% c("不", "没") & (prev_gloss == next_gloss | startsWith(next_gloss, prev_gloss))) |
        (gloss == "不是" & prev_gloss == "是") |
        (gloss == "没有" & prev_gloss == "有")
      ) ~ "A_not_A",
      
      # Utterance-final negative alternative in a question.
      prev_adj & is_end & (
        coalesce(utterance_type == "interrogative", FALSE) |
        prev_gloss %in% c("了", "过", "好", "完")
      ) ~ "final_alternative_question",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    word          = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", word),
    word_category = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", word_category),
    syncategory   = if_else(!is.na(negation_exclusion), "nonfunction", syncategory)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-prev_adj, -next_adj, -is_end)
```

## Sentential vs. Discourse negation

Eligible negators are classified as sentential, discourse, or uncertain using their position, neighboring part-of-speech tags, punctuation, and particles within the same utterance. The summary reports counts for each negator and scope across both child and parent speech.

- **Sentential:** Negation associated with a predicate or nominal expression, identified through the  specified grammatical patterns.
  Example: 我 (wo) 不 (bu) 去 (qu), “I am not going.”

- **Discourse:** Negation used as a standalone response or an utterance-initial correction, identified through position, punctuation, and particle patterns.
  Example: 不 (bu)，是 (shi) 狗 (gou), “No, it is a dog.”

- **Uncertain:** An eligible negator that matches neither the discourse nor the sentential rules. For example, a noninitial 不 (bu) followed by a word
  with a missing POS tag may remain uncertain when no other rule applies.

**Rule order:** Excluded structures receive no scope label. For eligible negators, manual labels take priority, followed by discourse rules and then sentential rules. Unmatched cases are labeled uncertain.

Classification does not examine preceding conversational turns. Standalone negatives therefore default to discourse unless manually overridden.

```{r negation_categorization}
manual_negation_scope <- character(0)

pure_discourse_particles <- c(
  "啊", "呀", "吧", "呢", "啦", "哦", "哈",
  "哇", "呗", "嘛", "哼", "哎", "么", "哩"
)

if (
  length(manual_negation_scope) > 0 &&
  (
    is.null(names(manual_negation_scope)) ||
    any(names(manual_negation_scope) == "") ||
    anyDuplicated(names(manual_negation_scope)) > 0 ||
    !all(manual_negation_scope %in%
           c("sentential", "discourse", "uncertain"))
  )
) {
  stop("Manual negation-scope codes must have unique case IDs and valid labels.")
}

mandarin_tokens <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    .case_id = str_c(
      transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order,
      sep = "|"
    ),

    .is_split = coalesce(
      (gloss == "不" & next_gloss == "是") |
        (gloss == "没" & next_gloss == "有"),
      FALSE
    ),
    
    .target_next_pos = toupper(trimws(coalesce(
      if_else(.is_split, next2_pos, next_pos), ""
    ))),

    .target_next_gloss = if_else(
      .is_split, next2_gloss, next_gloss
    ),

    .prev_pos_upper = toupper(
      trimws(coalesce(prev_pos, ""))
    ),

    .current_pos_upper = toupper(trimws(coalesce(part_of_speech, ""))),

    .is_utt_start = is.na(prev_gloss) | prev_gloss == "",

    .has_prev_context = .prev_pos_upper %in%
      c("NOUN", "PRON", "PROPN", "DET", "ADP"),

    .tail_token_ok =
      .current_pos_upper %in% c("PUNCT", "INTJ", "SFP") |
      gloss %in% pure_discourse_particles |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(gloss, ""),
        "^[，。！？、；：,.!?;:…]+$"
      ),

    .tail_all_clean = rev(cumall(rev(.tail_token_ok))),

    .is_standalone = .is_utt_start &
      if_else(
        .is_split,
        is.na(next2_gloss) | next2_gloss == "",
        is.na(next_gloss) | next_gloss == ""
      ),

    .is_pure_discourse_response = .is_utt_start &
      if_else(
        .is_split,
        coalesce(lead(.tail_all_clean, 2L), FALSE),
        coalesce(lead(.tail_all_clean), FALSE)
      ),

    .is_turn_initial_discourse = .is_utt_start &
      (
        .target_next_pos == "PUNCT" |
          str_detect(
            coalesce(.target_next_gloss, ""),
            "^[，。！？、；：,.!?;:…]+$"
          )
      ),

    negation_scope = case_when(

  is.na(negation_category) |
    !is.na(negation_exclusion) ~ NA_character_,

  .case_id %in% names(manual_negation_scope) ~
    unname(manual_negation_scope[.case_id]),

  .is_standalone |
    .is_pure_discourse_response |
    .is_turn_initial_discourse ~ "discourse",

  negation_category %in% c("不", "没") &
    .target_next_pos %in%
      c("VERB", "AUX", "ADJ", "ADV", "ADP", "SCONJ") ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category %in% c("没", "没有", "不是") &
    .target_next_pos %in%
      c("NOUN", "PRON", "PROPN", "NUM", "DET", "N:LET", "L2") ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category %in% c("不是", "没有") &
    (
      .has_prev_context |
        .target_next_pos %in%
          c("VERB", "AUX", "ADJ", "ADV", "ADP", "SCONJ")
    ) ~
    "sentential",

  negation_category == "没" &
    .has_prev_context &
    (
      is.na(.target_next_gloss) |
        .target_next_gloss == "" |
        .target_next_pos %in% c("PUNCT", "SFP") |
        .target_next_gloss %in% pure_discourse_particles
    ) ~
    "sentential",

  TRUE ~ "uncertain"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-starts_with("."))

negation_scope_counts_step3 <- mandarin_tokens %>%
  filter(!is.na(negation_scope)) %>%
  count(negation_category, negation_scope, name = "count") %>%
  complete(
    negation_category = negation_levels,
    negation_scope = c("sentential", "discourse", "uncertain"),
    fill = list(count = 0L)
  )
negation_scope_counts_step3
```

## Save Processed Data

Save the annotated token data as a Feather file, including context variables, function-word categories, negation exclusions, and scope labels.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(
  mandarin_tokens,
  file.path(processed_dir, "mandarin_tokens_processed.feather")
)
```
